title: G⁻¹(E) has locally finite perimeter in the chart ball (supplied step 2; Simon 6.2.35)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U, N, E ⊆ ℝ^P, ξN : ℝ^P → Λ_{n+1}(ℝ^P), T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), x ∈ ℝ^P, ι : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ^P a linear isometry, u : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ^P and δ₁, δ₂ ∈ ℝ. Write D := B_{δ₁}(0) ⊆ ℝ^{n+1}, G(v) := x + ιv + u(v), e_0, …, e_n for the standard basis and J(v) := (det[⟨ιe_i + Du(v)e_i, ιe_k + Du(v)e_k⟩]_{i,k})^{1/2}. Assume: E is Borel, E ⊆ N ∩ U, IsBoundaryOfRegion T E ξN (T(ω) = ∫_E ξN(dω) dH^{n+1} for ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U)), and T is integer multiplicity; δ₁ > 0, δ₂ > 0 and closedBall(x, δ₁ + δ₂) ⊆ U; u is C² on D; for every v ∈ D: u(v) ⊥ range ι, ‖Du(v)‖ ≤ 1, |u(v)| < δ₂/2, G(v) ∈ N, and ξN(G(v))(α)·J(v) = α(ιe_0 + Du(v)e_0, …, ιe_n + Du(v)e_n) for every (n+1)-covector α; and whenever |v| < δ₁, |h| < δ₂, h ⊥ range ι and x + ιv + h ∈ N, then h = u(v). Then F := D ∩ G^{-1}(E) is Borel, and for every compact K ⊆ D there is C ∈ ℝ such that ∫_F trace Dφ dL^{n+1} ≤ C for every C^∞ map φ : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ^{n+1} with compact support, tsupport φ ⊆ K and |φ(y)| ≤ 1 for all y.
